assessments.reasoning: The exact distribution specification distinguishes the plaintext document markup and typical structural or inline constructs from the parser supplied by Docutils.

challenge.method: Verify the source distribution against PyPI metadata and its package version. Compare the bundled source with the live reference, directive documentation and a pinned SciPy example using its own documentation tooling.
challenge.results: The specification establishes the markup language and parser-component relation. The downstream document and extension directives retain their distinct tooling and revision boundaries.

limitations: The source supports the language identity and Docutils parser relationship. Renderers, hosting tools and arbitrary directives are outside that exact identity assertion.
